user.title: Céleste – Add a celestial object
user.description: Choose the Sun, the Moon or a planet (local calculation, no Internet), another object (asteroid, comet, natural satellite, through the IMCCE online service) or astronomical time (Julian day, sidereal time, equation of time).

custom.title: Céleste – Custom object
custom.description: Enter the exact object name as recognized by IMCCE (e.g., Ceres, Halley, Io). The name will be validated against the API.

location.title: Céleste – Observer location
location.description: Observer coordinates (Home Assistant's by default). For astronomical time, only the longitude is used (local sidereal and solar time).

error.object_not_found: Object not found by the IMCCE API. Please check the name and type.

abort.already_configured: This celestial object is already configured.

convert_to_julian_day.name: Convert to Julian day
convert_to_julian_day.description: Calculates the Julian day of a Gregorian calendar date and time (Universal Time).

convert_to_gregorian.name: Convert Julian day to date
convert_to_gregorian.description: Calculates the date and time (Universal Time) of a Julian day.
